content: We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the described forward reaction: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse to expel Cl- and base deprotonates N-H to give sulfonamide. So functional group formed: sulfonamide (N-S bond). Broken bond: S-Cl bond. So forward reaction: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide + HCl (or base). In retrosynthesis, we break N-S bond and form S-Cl bond (i.e., we go from sulfonamide to sulfonyl chloride + amine). So we need a template that breaks N-S bond and forms S-Cl bond. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed? Actually forward reaction forms sulfonamide (functional group formed). In forward reaction, sulfonamide is formed, S-Cl broken. So criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamide"? Need list of functional groups available. Let's get list.
